summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing English translations of resolutions adopted at its 122nd Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting and an Extraordinary Report. The filing covers the election of board members, including Akio Toyoda as Chairman and Kenta Kon as President, and other corporate governance matters. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine periodic report of corporate actions and shareholder meeting outcomes. The filing does not trigger any special-situation classification.
